content.short: Tholos offers self-custodial MPC wallets for teams, with fiat rails, OTC and DeFi access.
content.description: Tholos gives crypto teams a self-custodial treasury built on MPC key management, so no single person holds a complete key while the organisation keeps control of its own assets. Around that it adds the operational pieces treasuries need: fiat rails, OTC execution and DeFi access across a few dozen chains from one dashboard.
